contract.entry: Existing moderation read family: /lockdown-records, optional bounded positive integer page, outcome lockdown_records, ephemeral defer/edit. Manage Channels and existing moderation/guild activation gates. No audit-reason argument.
contract.visibility: Builder supplies an inherent ChannelModerationRuntime::with_recovery_visibility_cache(Arc<twilight_cache_inmemory::InMemoryCache>) method and wires the same gateway cache in production. A test-only compatibility trait leaves the old runtime executable, not implemented. Effective actor ViewChannel comes from complete cached guild/member/role/channel evidence using existing permission precedence; Manage Channels is not Administrator. Missing facts fail closed, without fetching live overwrites or accepting a caller-provided visibility allowlist. A genuinely new security boundary still requires its own disposition before widening.
contract.projection: Complete authorized channel IDs, full saved instant, known/unknown setter, bounded inert reason, explicit saved recovery evidence rather than live/effective lockdown status, and current-channel /channel-inspect next action. No recovery masks or generations.
contract.pages: Ascending stable channel IDs, deterministic equal-time ties, at most ten rows per page, complete reachability across the 31-row fixture, stateless default page one, <=2000 UTF-16 units per response. Hidden/cold/foreign rows, including 40 leading cold IDs, do not change visible text, page continuation or totals. Empty, visibility unavailable, query failure and out-of-range pages are distinct.
contract.sql: The runtime executes actual guild-scoped ordered LIMIT queries, observed at the SQLx boundary. The observer has a real-store positive control, so an empty/silent observer cannot certify bounds or deny-before-read. Full recovery/audit/idempotency/lane snapshots and query receipts detect cleanup, claim/release or applied-audit writes.
contract.time: Two same-date offset-bearing saved instants remain distinct. Current-channel inspect uses the same full saved-time display. Malformed legacy times/setter IDs remain unknown. Equivalent RFC3339 offset/UTC or complete Discord instant tokens are accepted.
contract.effects: Inventory executes no live overwrite reads or channel/message HTTP mutations. Respond performs exactly one ephemeral defer and one original edit with empty allowed_mentions; rejected defer performs no SQL read or later HTTP. Authorization/invalid input fails before sensitive reads. No replay claim, lane claim/release, row cleanup, unlock, timer, recovery consumption or mutation audit is authorized.
contract.controls: Existing current-channel inspect/purge-preview and lockdown/unlock/slowmode definitions, permissions and runtime ownership remain protected controls. Run the unchanged planner, setter-provenance and moderation runtime targets to preserve manual unlock/exact recovery behavior. Builder owns generated-reference and complete-registry conformance via the existing canonical generators, not a second registry.
